instruction: Can you play this streaming video link: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_16x9/gear4/prog_index.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop_16x9 gear4 variant). Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_playing_info fetches VLC status XML from HTTP interface, extracting the current playing state
Metric logic is correct: is_vlc_playing checks both that VLC is in 'playing' state and that the URL matches the expected stream
Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator verifies both requirements - VLC is playing AND the correct URL is loaded
HLS stream handling: Metric implements robust URL matching with multiple strategies, including handling cases where VLC shows just the filename for HLS streams
Expected value is correct: The URL matches the instruction requirement exactly
Practical feasibility: VLC's HTTP interface provides real-time status that the getter can access at runtime
